source_action: Camargo-Molina, Markkanen, Scott, arXiv:1905.00045v2, literal Einstein action (5.2), post-inflaton small-positive-sigma limit
scope: Exploratory classical initial-state sensitivity calculation. Initial temperatures, positions and velocities are declared controls, not a distribution transported from inflation. Constant relativistic degrees of freedom and a stabilized h=0 phase are assumed until the stop temperature; no electroweak transition or present-day density fit is executed.
